import ThesisCommon.Analysis.GowersMaureyAdjointSpreads

/-! The actual tail spreads form the proper family generated by the shift.
Composition uses truncated subtraction in its domain and range cutoffs.
In this particular family even one fixed nonzero matrix entry determines
a finite set of parameters, which is stronger than the two-entry condition
in Gowers--Maurey, math/9407209, Section 3. -/
noncomputable section
namespace ThesisCommon.GowersMaurey
variable {𝕜 : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜]

theorem spread_comp (m n p q : ℕ) :
    (spread (𝕜 := 𝕜) m n).comp (spread p q) =
      spread (p + (m-q)) (n + (q-m)) := by
  apply Finsupp.lhom_ext
  intro i c
  change spread m n (spread p q (Finsupp.single i c)) = _
  by_cases hp : p ≤ i
  · by_cases hm : m ≤ i-p+q
    · have hnew : p+(m-q) ≤ i := by omega
      simp only [spread_single, if_pos hp, if_pos hm, if_pos hnew]
      congr 1
      omega
    · have hnew : ¬ p+(m-q) ≤ i := by omega
      simp only [spread_single, if_pos hp, if_neg hm, if_neg hnew]
  · have hnew : ¬ p+(m-q) ≤ i := by omega
    simp only [spread_single, if_neg hp, if_neg hnew, map_zero]

theorem spread_entry_ne_zero_iff (m n i j : ℕ) :
    spread m n (Finsupp.single j (1 : 𝕜)) i ≠ 0 ↔
      m ≤ j ∧ j-m+n = i := by
  classical
  by_cases hm : m ≤ j
  · simp only [spread_single, if_pos hm, Finsupp.single_apply]
    by_cases he : j-m+n = i <;> simp [hm, he]
  · simp [spread_single, hm]

theorem spread_parameters_injective :
    Function.Injective (fun z : ℕ × ℕ => spread (𝕜 := 𝕜) z.1 z.2) := by
  rintro ⟨m,n⟩ ⟨p,q⟩ he
  have hmn : spread m n (Finsupp.single m (1 : 𝕜)) n ≠ 0 :=
    (spread_entry_ne_zero_iff m n n m).mpr (by simp)
  have hpq : spread p q (Finsupp.single p (1 : 𝕜)) q ≠ 0 :=
    (spread_entry_ne_zero_iff p q q p).mpr (by simp)
  change spread (𝕜 := 𝕜) m n = spread p q at he
  rw [he] at hmn
  rw [← he] at hpq
  have hpm := (spread_entry_ne_zero_iff p q n m).mp hmn
  have hmp := (spread_entry_ne_zero_iff m n q p).mp hpq
  have hmp' : m = p := Nat.le_antisymm hmp.1 hpm.1
  subst p
  have hnq : n = q := by simpa using hmp.2
  subst q
  rfl

theorem finite_spread_nonzero_entry_parameters (i j : ℕ) :
    {z : ℕ × ℕ | spread z.1 z.2 (Finsupp.single j (1 : 𝕜)) i ≠ 0}.Finite := by
  apply ((Finset.range (j+1)).product (Finset.range (i+1))).finite_toSet.subset
  rintro ⟨m,n⟩ h
  have hh := (spread_entry_ne_zero_iff m n i j).mp h
  change (m,n) ∈ (Finset.range (j+1)).product (Finset.range (i+1))
  exact Finset.mem_product.mpr
    ⟨Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega), Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega)⟩

theorem finite_spread_two_nonzero_entry_parameters (i j k l : ℕ) :
    {z : ℕ × ℕ | spread z.1 z.2 (Finsupp.single j (1 : 𝕜)) i ≠ 0 ∧
      spread z.1 z.2 (Finsupp.single l (1 : 𝕜)) k ≠ 0}.Finite :=
  (finite_spread_nonzero_entry_parameters (𝕜 := 𝕜) i j).subset (fun _ h => h.1)

def tailSpreadFamily (𝕜 : Type*) [RCLike 𝕜] : Set (C00 𝕜 →ₗ[𝕜] C00 𝕜) :=
  Set.range (fun z : ℕ × ℕ => spread z.1 z.2)

theorem tailSpreadFamily_countable : (tailSpreadFamily 𝕜).Countable :=
  Set.countable_range _

theorem tailSpreadFamily_comp {S T : C00 𝕜 →ₗ[𝕜] C00 𝕜}
    (hS : S ∈ tailSpreadFamily 𝕜) (hT : T ∈ tailSpreadFamily 𝕜) :
    S.comp T ∈ tailSpreadFamily 𝕜 := by
  obtain ⟨⟨m,n⟩,rfl⟩ := hS
  obtain ⟨⟨p,q⟩,rfl⟩ := hT
  exact ⟨⟨p+(m-q),n+(q-m)⟩, (spread_comp m n p q).symm⟩

theorem tailSpreadFamily_adjoint {S : C00 𝕜 →ₗ[𝕜] C00 𝕜}
    (hS : S ∈ tailSpreadFamily 𝕜) :
    ∃ T ∈ tailSpreadFamily 𝕜, ∀ a x, pairing (S a) x = pairing a (T x) := by
  obtain ⟨⟨m,n⟩,rfl⟩ := hS
  exact ⟨spread n m, ⟨⟨n,m⟩,rfl⟩, pairing_spread_left m n⟩

theorem finite_tailSpreadFamily_two_entries (i j k l : ℕ) :
    {S ∈ tailSpreadFamily 𝕜 | S (Finsupp.single j 1) i ≠ 0 ∧
      S (Finsupp.single l 1) k ≠ 0}.Finite := by
  apply ((finite_spread_two_nonzero_entry_parameters (𝕜 := 𝕜) i j k l).image
    (fun z : ℕ × ℕ => spread (𝕜 := 𝕜) z.1 z.2)).subset
  rintro S ⟨⟨z,rfl⟩,h⟩
  exact ⟨z,h,rfl⟩

end ThesisCommon.GowersMaurey
